source_ref.title_or_campaign: 토스 숨은 서비스 2 — ATM 현금 출금

target_demo: 20-40 Korean adults; mobile-first users who occasionally need cash but have no card or cash on hand, and shop at convenience stores
narrative_arc: Opens on a relatable cash-crisis pain point — a wallet is opened on a table and there is no usable card and no cash inside ('카드도 안되고 / 현금도 없는 / 위기의 순간!'). A young adult in a study then holds up a small fan of banknotes to camera while an editorial caption bar frames the feature as 'a tip for finding cash right now when you have no wallet' (지갑 없을 때 / 당장 현금 찾는 꿀팁). The ad becomes a step-by-step in-app walkthrough shot as a flat-lay phone-on-green screen demo: open the all-tab and choose 'ATM 현금 출금', tap '주변 ATM 찾기' to see nearby convenience-store ATMs on a map, pick the ATM you'll visit and enter the withdrawal amount, confirm from your account and tap withdraw, and an approval number is issued. The ad then cuts to warm-cool handheld live action at a convenience-store ATM: the same adult walks up to a blue cardless ATM, selects Toss on the machine, enters her birth date and the six-digit approval number, the machine counts and dispenses cash, and she walks away holding the bills with a thumbs-up — 'card-free, this easily you can withdraw cash'. Series end card reveals 'Curator T / 토스를 발견하다'.

production_signature.signature_note: Two visual registers cut together: (1) live-action shots — warm shallow-DOF interior shots of a Korean adult opening a wallet and holding cash in a cozy study, plus cooler handheld on-location shots at a convenience-store cardless ATM — and (2) flat-lay top-down phone-on-vivid-green screen-demo shots used for the step-by-step UI walkthrough. The walkthrough segments carry hardcoded lower-third caption pills (dark rounded pill, bold white Korean text) synced to the voiceover; the live-action opening uses large centered white captions and a flat editorial 'CONTENT' header bar, and the live-action location shots carry the same dark caption pill. The series end card is a distinctive pixel/CRT-distorted logo badge ('Curator T / 토스를 발견하다') with sketch-stroke RGB chromatic-aberration text on a textured matte off-white paper field. Wiggle metric mean_abs_shift_x 0.45 with sign_flips 0.30 reads as ordinary handheld motion, NOT stereoscopic parallax: the interior and convenience-store shots are gentle-to-active handheld, the flat-lay UI and end card are locked off. No stereoscopic wiggle_3d.
